## Problem and change

Describe the concrete issue and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. Explain skips or remaining uncertainty. Include sample-only screenshots for UI changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or the reason tests are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] Existing media, saved clips, cancellation, and transcript edits are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, private footage, transcripts, model weights, or generated output are included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets include license information when applicable.
